runs.message:
Fix CI first-run deadlock, Firefox launch, and history git access

- Run e2e/axe against the same QUALITY_REPORT Build A used.
- Set HOME=/root so Firefox launches inside the Playwright container.
- Render an empty state when there are no previous runs, and only assert
  run rows/stages the report actually contains; the latest run is never
  in its own history, so the old assertion could never pass.
- Mark the workspace as a git safe.directory before recording history.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
